name: Allaid
text: Allaid is a druid in the Ossianic prose of James Macpherson from the year 1760. Macpherson gives him the title son of the rock. The name plays on the Old Irish word for the wild and notes his life among rocks and caverns.

attributes.attribute: druid in the prose of Macpherson called son of the rock
